content.text: Analyze this image for watermarks, logos, or overlaid text that are NOT part of the product itself. Look for semi-transparent overlays, repeated patterns, brand logos, or text that appears to be added on top of the product image. Product labels, part numbers, or text that's physically printed on the product should NOT be considered watermarks. Return ONLY valid JSON with the specified schema. If uncertain, use false.
